title: Free kundli online: what "free" actually means | Ask Tota
description: Computing a birth chart costs almost nothing. So the money is somewhere else. Here are the four business models behind a free kundli, and what you are paying with instead.
og_title: Free kundli online: what free actually means
og_description: Chart calculation is cheap. The revenue is elsewhere. Four models, one honest checklist, and why two free kundlis disagree.
h1: a free kundli costs almost nothing to make
dek: which is exactly why it is free everywhere. the maths is a solved problem and the compute is negligible. so the money is somewhere else in the building, and it is worth knowing where before u type ur birth details into anything.

faq.q: why is a kundli free everywhere?
faq.a: because computing one is genuinely cheap. the planetary positions come from a standard ephemeris and the rest is arithmetic. the marginal cost of one more chart is close to nothing, so nobody can charge for it.

faq.q: so how do free kundli sites make money?
faq.a: four ways, usually in combination: advertising, upselling a paid consultation, commission on remedies and gemstones, and a freemium subscription. the chart is the hook, not the product.

the astronomy usually is, because everyone is drawing from the same ephemeris data. what differs is the ayanamsa, the house system and how the birth place and time zone were resolved. those are settings, and they change the answer.

faq.q: why do two free kundlis give me different charts?
faq.a: different ayanamsa is the most common reason. after that: tropical instead of sidereal, a different house system, or a birth place that resolved to the wrong time zone.

faq.q: what am i actually giving up for a free kundli?
faq.a: ur date, exact time and place of birth, and usually a phone number or email. that combination is unusually identifying, and it is worth knowing where it goes.

faq.q: what does the law say about my birth data?
faq.a: in india, the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 covers it. u are entitled to know what is collected and why, and to ask for it to be deleted. an app with no delete option is worth asking about.

faq.q: what should i get for free?
faq.a: the chart itself, every graha with its degree and nakshatra, the lagna, the house layout, and ur vimshottari dasha dates. all of that is arithmetic and none of it is worth charging for.

faq.q: what is fair to pay for?
faq.a: interpretation, a person's time, and the ongoing work of maintaining a product. those are real costs. the chart calculation is not.

faq.q: should i give my phone number to get a kundli?
faq.a: that is ur call, but notice what it is for. a phone number is not needed to compute a chart. it is needed to contact u later, which tells u what the business model is.
not mathematically. language is a presentation layer. run the same checks: ayanamsa, house system, whether the degrees are visible.

faq.q: what if i do not know my exact birth time?
faq.a: a good tool will tell u that the lagna and the houses are unavailable and still give u sun, moon, nakshatra and dasha. one that silently uses noon is handing u twelve confident house placements that are probably wrong.

faq.q: how do i check a free kundli is right?
faq.a: cross-check the moon sign against what ur family has always called ur rashi, confirm the ayanamsa is lahiri, and confirm the birth place resolved to the correct time zone. those three catch nearly every error.
